Post Office Box No. 1        263 Kiangse Road        Telephone 10083

Shanghai, China    22 November, 1937,

S. C. Young Esqre.,
Deputy-Commissioner,
S.M.C. Police Force,
185 Foochow Road,
Shanghai.

Dear Mr. Young:

Can you give me any information regarding an Ameri-
can by the name of John Bresnan who claims to have been employed
for several years as a member of the Shanghai River Police (four
or five years).

A man by this name has made application to a very fine Ameri-
can business organization in Honolulu. The Managing Director, a
personal friend of mine, has asked me to check up on certain claims
he makes regarding his alleged life, employment and experience in
China.

He claims to have lived in the Orient for about 15 years. A
year or two of this in the Philippines but most of the time in
China. The letter of enquiry does not state at what period of
his residence here he was employed in the Shanghai River Police,
but his other employment mention -- more recently with the
British-American Tobacco Company -- would indicate that his
Police employment was probably ten or more years ago. He is now
said to be 33 years of age.

He appears to have left here some time in August or Septem-
ber. He claims to have been married and to have owned a home in
Chapei.

Any information you can give me will be appreciated very
much and will be considered entirely confidential.

Yours sincerely,

A. R. Hager

P.A. & D.C. (Dicto)

亲爱的杨先生：

能否提供有关一名叫约翰·布雷斯南（John Bresnan）的美国人的任何信息？他声称曾作为上海水上警察队成员任职数年（四或五年）。

名叫此名者已向火奴鲁鲁一家优秀的美国商业机构提出申请。我的个人好友、该公司的董事总经理要求我核实他就其所谓在中国的生活、就业和经历所提出的某些主张。

他声称在东方生活了约15年。其中一两年在菲律宾，但大部分时间在中国。查询信并未说明他在沪居住期间何时受雇于上海水上警察队，但他提到的其他工作经历——较近时期在英美烟草公司——表明他的警察任职时间可能在十年前或更久。据说他现年33岁。

他似乎是在八月或九月间的某个时候离开这里的。他声称已婚，并在闸北拥有一处住宅。

如蒙提供任何信息，将不胜感激，并将视为绝对机密。

此致，

A. R. 哈格（A. R. Hager）

私人助理兼副警务处长（口授）

Nov. 26, 1937.

The Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

（批：D. 8239 ...）

Sir:

On behalf of a client, we are desirous of obtaining information about one John Bresnan, who formerly resided in Shanghai. We quote as follows from our client's letter:

"His name is John Bresnan. He is approximately 33 years old, weighs about 210 pounds, and has spent fifteen years in the Orient. He was a Second Lieutenant in the Shanghai Volunteer Reserve Corps. He originally went to the Federated Malay States as a field boss and was there two years, then left for China. As near as we can make out he was a member of the Shanghai River Police for four or five years and later worked for the British American Tobacco Company in Shanghai. Then he left Shanghai to go to the Philippine Tobacco Company at Mindanao, taking charge of their personnel. He left this company about 1930 or 1931 and returned to Shanghai, where he again went to work for the British American Tobacco Company, remaining there until the company closed on account of the present war."

Will you kindly make such inquiries as may seem necessary to supply information concerning the present whereabouts, reputation and ability of this party. In reporting to our client we will, of course, not mention the fact that the information was obtained through you.

Thanking you for your assistance and any information you may be able to send us, we have the honour to be,

Sir,
Very respectfully yours,
RODGER & WIENER.

Rodger Wiener

HDR/C.

上海。

（批：D. 8239 ...）

先生：

受一位客户委托，我方希望获取有关前居上海人士约翰·布雷斯南（John Bresnan）的信息。兹摘录客户来信如下：

“他名叫约翰·布雷斯南。年龄约33岁，体重约210磅，在东方生活了十五年。他曾是上海商团后备队（Shanghai Volunteer Reserve Corps）的中尉。他最初前往马来亚联合邦担任田间工头，在那里待了两年，随后前往中国。据我们要略推断，他曾在上海水上警察队服役四至五年，后来在上海为英美烟草公司工作。之后他离开上海前往棉兰老岛的菲律宾烟草公司，负责人事工作。他大约在1930年或1931年离开该公司返回上海，再次进入英美烟草公司工作，直至该公司因当前战争而停业。”

恳请进行必要的调查，以提供关于此人目前下落、声誉及能力的信息。在向我们的客户汇报时，我们当然不会提及信息是通过贵方获得的。

感谢阁下的协助以及可能提供的任何信息，此致，

先生，
您最恭敬的，
罗杰与维纳律师事务所。

罗杰 维纳

HDR/C.
